jobs.description: SamenvattingAre you looking for a long-term job in a dynamic international environment? This opportunity as a Production Worker in the food industry in Brielle might be just what you’re looking for. Read on and apply now! Good work!Over de functieAs a Production Worker, you will work with salads and pre-cut vegetables in a clean and modern production facility. Your main tasks include:   - Packing vegetables into containers  - Weighing salads  - Preparing and packaging salads  - Keeping your workstation clean and following hygiene standards  - Checking product quality during your shift  - Assisting with restocking supplies on the production line  The facility operates under strict hygiene rules. You will work in shifts from Monday to Sunday (with one or more days off), starting between 6:00 and 7:00 AM and finishing between 3:00 and 4:00 PM. Work hours may change depending on production needs. Please note that artificial eyelashes, nail polish, and any jewelry (such as earrings, rings, or watches) are not allowed on the production floor for safety and hygiene reasons. Over het bedrijfAt Tuinderij Vers, you will join a leader in freshly cut vegetables and salads. The company is dedicated to delivering top-quality, ready-to-eat vegetable products like mixed lettuce, raw vegetable mixes, stir-fry packs, and meal salads. Most of the production process is automated, helping the team of about 400 colleagues work efficiently and safely. You’ll be part of a motivated, international team that shares a common goal—providing the very best products to customers every day. The atmosphere is professional but friendly, with clear communication and a commitment to teamwork. As a logistics employee, you handle incoming and outgoing goods every day. You unpack and check products, and prepare them for shipment. You also ensure the warehouse remains tidy and organized. You work with scanners and sometimes a forklift. Working hours are flexible, and you can work either full-time or part-time. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that customers receive their orders on time. You need to work in 3 shifts; morningshift (7:00-15:30), afternoonshift (15:00-23:30) and nightshift (23:00-7:30). You are someone who likes to roll up their sleeves and enjoys working as part of a team. You value completing tasks neatly and on time. You are capable of working accurately and have no trouble standing or walking during your shift. You have a reasonable command of spoken and written English, enabling effective communication within the team. Logistics experience is a plus but not a requirement—you are a quick learner!Mandatory requirements:- You have at least a VMBO level of education/aptitude- You speak and write English- You live within 20 km of Lelystad

As a Finisher, you are responsible for the final step in the production process. Using a work instruction, you carefully finish the produced pots. Functie eisen As a Finisher Employee, you meet the following: - You have some experience as a production employee; - You can function well both independently and in a team; - And you speak Dutch and English. Keep a high-tech factory moving In a high-tech manufacturing environment, having the right material available at the right moment is essential. A missing component, delayed delivery or unreliable supplier can directly impact production. As an Operational Buyer, you will take responsibility for the operational purchasing process and the availability of materials and components. Suppliers and commercial agreements are already in place; your focus is on making sure purchase orders are executed correctly, deliveries arrive as promised and potential supply issues are addressed before they impact the factory. This is a hands-on role where you will be in direct contact with suppliers and work closely with planning, manufacturing and logistics. You will monitor the supply situation, manage changing priorities and take ownership when deliveries or material availability are at risk. Your work will include: Managing and following up on purchase orders for technical materials and components. Monitoring delivery performance and acting when suppliers are at risk of missing agreed lead times. Maintaining direct contact with suppliers regarding order status, delays and delivery commitments. Coordinating material availability with planning and manufacturing teams. Taking ownership of shortages, supply disruptions and other operational issues until they are resolved. Escalating critical supply issues and coordinating actions with the right internal and external stakeholders. Making operational purchasing decisions based on lead times, delivery requirements and costs. Identifying recurring supply issues and contributing to structural improvements. Maintaining accurate purchasing and material data in SAP or another ERP system. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A gross monthly salary between €3,600 and €5,100, excluding holiday allowance. 25 vacation days, excluding public holidays, plus 13 ADV days. Pension scheme and travel allowance. A personal development and growth plan. Opportunities to furthedevelop yourself within purchasing, supply chain and high-tech manufacturing. A dynamic and international working environment. Free lunch or dinner at the location. Access to free sports facilities on campus. Wat levert deze baan jou op? This role offers you the opportunity to work at the operational heart of a complex high-tech manufacturing environment. You will take ownership of the purchasing process and work closely with suppliers, planning, manufacturing and logistics to ensure materials and components are available when needed. It is a hands-on position with plenty of responsibility and variety. You will develop your experience in operational purchasing, supplier management and supply chain coordination while working with complex technical products and an international supplier network. The role also offers plenty of opportunities to grow within a large and technologically advanced organization, where different engineering and supply chain disciplines work closely together. Functie-eisen You could currently be working as an Operational Buyer, Buyer, Purchasing Specialist, Procurement Specialist, Material Planner or Supply Chain Coordinator. What matters most is that you understand the operational side of purchasing and know how to keep materials flowing within a production environment. We are looking for someone who has: At least 3 years of experience in operational purchasing, procurement, supply chain or material planning. Experience managing purchase orders and working directly with suppliers. Experience within a technical, manufacturing or industrial environment. The ability to manage multiple priorities and remain structured when circumstances change. A proactive mindset and a strong sense of ownership. The confidence to challenge suppliers and escalate issues when necessary. Experience with SAP or another ERP system. Good communication skills and a strong command of English.
